case_number: Civil Appeal Nos.3895-3896 of 2023 (Arising out of S.L.P. (C) Nos.7219-7220 of 2018)
summary: Election petition challenging improper nomination acceptance and corrupt practices; requirements under Section 83(1)(a)(b) RP Act 1951 for material facts and corrupt practice particulars; Election Commission postponement history; failure to specify corrupt practice details in petition; reliance on forwarded video/audio evidence without incorporation; High Court's direction to supplement evidence improper; hyper-technicality vs liberal pleading standards in election petitions; no cause of action for corrupt practices established.
legal_provisions_cited: Representation of the People Act, 1951 s.81
Representation of the People Act, 1951 s.83(1)(a)(b)
Representation of the People Act, 1951 s.123
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Rule 16 Order VI
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Rule 11 Order VII
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court direction to file supplementary documents set aside; Election Petition deemed to lack cause of action for corrupt practices allegations.
